correctness.rationale: Exterior-square character of standard S_n representation is H(k,m)=((k-1)(k-2))/2-m and the two-subset minus trivial and standard character is T(k,m)=k(k-1)/2+m-k. Averaging any real projection under both left/right regular actions reduces the minimum norm on each full coefficient block to the unique central projector d E|χ|; no confusion with a single matrix-coefficient copy or Johnson-scheme projection. Derangements avoiding 1- and 2-cycles give q_r recurrence and rational finite gaps. Independently recomputed exact gaps for n=4..30, including -11/12,7/6,-49/60,-44/45,4313/20160 for n=4..8, and checked the n30 rational Poisson-mass difference within (1/40,1/38) with stated 120022/2^30 error. Analytic entire-function Cauchy bound |E_n f-L_f|<=60011/2^n plus B_n-A_n>1/41 for n>=30 and A_n<=1 completes infinite sign cutoff. Consequently first n=5 and all n>=8 two-row wins; no equality; normalized gap tends δ in (1/40,1/38).
